Read the second time and placed on the calendar

form.official-title: To amend title VI of the Social Security Act to remove the prohibition on States and territories against lowering their taxes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Let States Cut Taxes Act.

section.header: Removal of restriction of use of Coronavirus State Fiscal Recovery funds

subsection.text: Paragraph (2) of section 602(c) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 802(c)) is amended to read as follows:

paragraph.header: Further restriction on use of funds
paragraph.text: No State or territory may use funds made available under this section for deposit into any pension fund.

subsection.text: Section 602 of such Act (42 U.S.C. 802) is further amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (d)(2)(A), by striking , including, in the case of a State or a territory, all modifications to the State's or territory's tax revenue sources during the covered period;
in subsection (e), by striking such subsection, and all that follows through the period and inserting such subsection.; and

subparagraph.text: by redesignating paragraphs (2) through (7) as paragraphs (1) through (6), respectively.

subsection.text: The amendments made by this section shall take effect as if enacted on March 12, 2021.

endorsement.action-desc: Read the second time and placed on the calendar
